# Sangmin Lee (이상민)
Ph.D. Student, School of Electronic and Electrical Engineering, Kyungpook National University
Lab: PLAYWAVE Lab (https://playwave.knu.ac.kr/)
Site: https://sangmin2-rf.github.io

## About
I am a Ph.D. student in the School of Electronic and Electrical Engineering at Kyungpook National University (KNU), advised by Prof. Sangjo Choi in the PLAYWAVE Lab. I received the B.S. degree from the University of Ulsan in 2021 and the M.S. degree from KNU in 2024.
My research focuses on controlling electromagnetic waves with metasurfaces and antenna arrays — from unit-cell design and full-wave simulation to PCB prototyping, anechoic-chamber pattern measurement, and over-the-air link validation.
My doctoral research on a Moiré-based transparent transmissive RIS for 6G outdoor-to-indoor links is supported by the NRF Ph.D. Student Research Grant (RS-2026-25552947).

## Research interests
- Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces for 6G Upper Mid-Band
- Millimeter-Wave Series-Fed Arrays for Automotive Radar
- Metasurface-Enabled Electromagnetic Computing and Imaging
- Beam-Steering Phased Arrays for SATCOM
